title: Bosentan alone against an inactive control in pulmonary arterial hypertension: four eligible trials, and not one registering an endpoint this review could pool
question: In adults with WHO group 1 pulmonary arterial hypertension, what is the effect of bosentan compared with placebo or no active pulmonary vasodilator on exercise capacity and on clinical worsening?
question_provenance: One of the four readings `bosentan-pah` was split into on 2026-08-19. The parent's question was the OBJECT'S OWN VERDICT with a question mark appended.

split_provenance.why_split: The parent asked at least four questions under one title and its two trials fell on opposite sides of the split -- COMPASS-2 (combination) and FUTURE-2 (children, open-label, no control arm, primary is growth). See DECIDED-bosentan-pah-2026-08-19.md. P21.
split_provenance.precedence: The four readings are NOT mutually exclusive by construction -- a trial can be paediatric and group-1 and a combination design at once -- so an assignment rule is required. It is D children > C not-WHO-group-1 > B combination > A monotherapy, applied in that order, each step naming the field it reads. A DIFFERENT PRECEDENCE WOULD MOVE TRIALS BETWEEN READINGS AND THESE COUNTS WOULD CHANGE WITH IT, which is why it is written down as a choice rather than presented as a discovery.

outcomes.definition_note: This reading registers no shared estimand. The definition above names what a pooled outcome WOULD have been, and the page reports why there is none rather than leaving the slot blank.

withholding_question.question: does each eligible trial register, at ANY rank, a six-minute walk distance CHANGE, or a clinical-worsening / morbidity-mortality outcome, before any decision about which trials can be combined?
withholding_question.detected_structurally_not_by_keyword: a walk-distance term plus a change term; a worsening or event term in a disease context. Never a registered phrase, which would find only the trials that already agree.
withholding_question.answer: NO, AND FOR EVERY ONE OF THE FOUR. Asked at every registered rank before any pooling decision; not one eligible trial registers a walk CHANGE or a clinical-worsening outcome.

exercise_or_worsening.poolable_reason: FOUR TRIALS ARE ELIGIBLE AND NONE REGISTERS AN ENDPOINT THIS REVIEW CAN POOL. Not one of the four registers a six-minute walk distance CHANGE or a clinical-worsening outcome at any rank. The two that have posted results register 'Total Exercise Time on the Exercise Echocardiogram' (n=5, TERMINATED) and 'Insulin Resistance Profile Change - Triglyceride:HDL Cholesterol Ratio' (n=2, TERMINATED). AND THE READING'S ANCHOR TRIAL REGISTERS NO MEASURABLE ENDPOINT AT ALL: EARLY (NCT00091715, n=185) declares the two-word primaries 'exercise capacity' and 'cardiac hemodynamics' -- no measure, no timepoint, no direction -- and has posted no results. A REVIEW CANNOT POOL A CONSTRUCT.
exercise_or_worsening.and_the_weaker_limb_is_reported_too: TWO of the four name a walk-distance endpoint AT ALL, as a bare construct with no change term, timepoint or direction. THE GAP BETWEEN 0 AND 2 IS THE FINDING: registrations too thin to establish a shared estimand look identical to registrations that establish one until both limbs are counted. Treating a bare construct as a change endpoint would be inferring the analysis from the name.

r_output._why_absent: k=4 and nothing was pooled, so there is NO model call to quote, NO pooled estimate, NO heterogeneity and NO package version. This is not a missing artefact; it is the correct state for a topic with no synthesis.
r_output.what_would_hold_P6: an estimand shared by two or more eligible trials.
r_output.heterogeneity_reason: Undefined: no between-study variance was estimated because no model was run.
r_output.what_would_change_it: An estimand shared by two or more included trials. Where k is already above 1 and nothing pooled, the obstacle is the ESTIMAND rather than the evidence base, and this field must say which.

screening.search_note: Executed 2026-08-19. 57 registrations surfaced by ONE search over the drug; the four readings are applied after it, by a stated precedence.
screening.eligibility: POPULATION: adults with WHO group 1 pulmonary arterial hypertension. INTERVENTION: bosentan as the randomised intervention -- NOT named in an arm description as prior or background therapy, which is how two records entered other readings wrongly. COMPARATOR: placebo or no active pulmonary vasodilator; a trial in which a second PAH-specific drug is part of the contrast belongs to the COMBINATION reading. ESTIMAND, which governs POOLABILITY and not eligibility: a six-minute walk distance CHANGE, or a clinical-worsening / morbidity-mortality outcome, at ANY rank. Criteria are DERIVED POST HOC and say so.

eligibility_provenance.precedence: The four readings are NOT mutually exclusive by construction -- a trial can be paediatric and group-1 and a combination design at once -- so an assignment rule is required. eligibility_provenance.adjudication: TWO RECORDS WERE ADJUDICATED OUT OF THEIR READINGS, both for one reason. NCT04273945 (macitentan 75 mg vs 10 mg) names bosentan in its ARM DESCRIPTION as a prior exposure participants must come off; NCT01824290 (tadalafil in children) names it as an EXAMPLE OF A CLASS in a background record attached to BOTH arms. `locate()` scored both EXPERIMENTAL because its step-1 scan reads arm DESCRIPTIONS while its control-arm test reads intervention NAMES only -- an asymmetry built deliberately for DAPA-HF and wrong here. A DRUG NAMED IN AN ARM DESCRIPTION AS PRIOR OR BACKGROUND THERAPY IS NOT THE RANDOMISED INTERVENTION, and where the mention is identical in every arm it is by construction not the contrast.

manuscript.introduction:
This review asks: In adults with WHO group 1 pulmonary arterial hypertension, what is the effect of bosentan compared with placebo or no active pulmonary vasodilator on exercise capacity and on clinical worsening?

It examines 4 randomised trials and DOES NOT POOL THEM, against placebo or an inactive control.

The outcome sought is Six-minute walk distance change, or clinical worsening.

Everything in this paragraph is derived from stored fields and none of it is authored. The interpretive sentences that follow are marked as drafts and are the author's to replace.
